RUST_LOG.description: Log verbosity: error, warn, info, debug, trace.

AUTH_TOKEN.description: Optional upload lock-down. When set, every POST / requires 'Authorization: Bearer *** with this value (401 without); reading existing pastes stays public. Blank = open public pastebin (the default).

DELETE_TOKEN.description: Optional admin delete. When set, enables DELETE /link for holders of this token. Blank = the delete endpoint is disabled (returns 404) — the safe public default.
